39inline constinit std::atomic<bool> terminationRequested{false};
40static_assert(std::atomic<bool>::is_always_lock_free);
41
45inline void installTerminationHandlers() {
46 const auto handler = [](int signal) {
47 if (signal == SIGINT || signal == SIGTERM) {
48 terminationRequested.store(true, std::memory_order_relaxed);
49 }
50 };
51 std::signal(SIGINT, handler);
52 std::signal(SIGTERM, handler);
53}
